{{Top|leg}}
'''House Sisemon''' was one of seventeen [[Noble/Legends|noble]] houses that settled in the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region after the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] implemented the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]. The house based itself in the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]].
